summary: Iteration-7 full-stack test of 'Scripture Reference styling' feature (separate color + size from verse text). Backend: PUT /api/appearance/bible accepts reference_size 1..10 (all persist via GET), rejects 0, 11, -1, 100 with HTTP 422; defaults endpoint returns reference_size=5; mutating reference_size leaves text_color/muted_color/background_color/panel_color unchanged; accent_color (which drives reference color) accepts arbitrary hex. 10/10 pytest tests pass. Frontend: /settings-admin PIN gate accepts 1234; Bible tab shows reference-panel with color-reference-picker/hex (bound to accent_color) and reference-size-slider (default value 5); Colors panel on Bible tab contains only Background, Verse text, Secondary text, Text panel (NO 'Reference' / accent_color row anymore). Register tab has NO reference-panel but keeps the accent 'This-week labels' color field in its Colors panel. Live preview iframe reflects changes instantly: changing hex to #22C55E flipped bible-reference color from rgb(245,158,11) to rgb(34,197,94); dragging reference-size slider to 10 grew bible-reference font-size from 43.2px to 70.2px; bible-verse-text color (rgb(248,250,252)) and font-size (71.28px) stayed unchanged, confirming reference styling is decoupled from verse text styling. Dirty indicator switches to 'Unsaved changes (preview only)'. Portrait fit check: published Esther 8:9 KJV (528 chars), set reference_size=10 via API, loaded /bible at 1080x1920 -> ref box y=460.7..566.0 (font 70.2px), verse box y=598.4..1375.1, both inside 1920 viewport, reference above verse. All state restored at end: bible appearance PUT back from snapshot (reference_size=5, accent_color=#F59E0B), /bible display cleared to idle. User's church_name 'Providence Baptist Church', logo, and bible background image preserved untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: appearance.py — reference_size is correctly validated as int in [1,10] with default 5, model-level validation produces 422 for out-of-range values. Reference color intentionally reuses accent_color (shared field) rather than adding a new column; this keeps the schema small and the ReferencePanel/ColorField binds to accent_color — acceptable design, though it means the Register tab's accent_color still represents 'This-week labels' while on Bible the same field is 'Reference color' (two labels for one field). Not a bug, but future maintainers should know they're the same persisted key.

AppearanceEditor.jsx — COLOR_LABELS.bible no longer includes accent_color, so the Bible Colors panel correctly omits a Reference row; the ReferencePanel is rendered only when display==='bible'. Clean separation.

DisplayBackground.jsx — --ss-ref-size formula `1.5 + reference_size*0.5` vmin maps 1..10 -> 2.0..6.5vmin; .bible-ref uses `max(0.9rem, var(--ss-ref-size))` to keep a sane floor. Preview iframe receives form via postMessage, so slider changes propagate immediately without hitting the backend — verified live.

FitText group (BibleDisplay.jsx) — includes bible-ref inside the measured group, so increasing reference_size shrinks the verse to fit; Esther 8:9 at ref_size=10 on 1080x1920 still fits with no clipping.

Cleared display and restored reference_size back to 5 and bible appearance to the opening snapshot at end of run. User's church_name/logo/background image untouched.
